name: agent-orchestra
description: Durable many-agent messaging with a hub, a conductor, and players across machines.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate many coding agents through a durable hub.
interface.longDescription: A durable hub on an always-on machine that carries mail for one conductor and any number of players and their children, over pinned TLS, with offline queueing and inbox monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Join an Agent Orchestra with this invite.
Assign a task to the orchestra players.
